title: MONETTE: A Randomized Phase II Study of Ceralasertib plus Durvalumab or Ceralasertib Monotherapy in Patients with Advanced Melanoma Resistant to PD-(L)1 Inhibition Ceralasertib ± Durvalumab in PD-(L)1–Resistant Melanoma
observations_or_assays: BICR-confirmed objective response rate per RECIST v1.1
time_scope: The main full-analysis-set results at the article’s reported data cutoff.
excluded: Investigator-assessed response, best-response categories, duration/time to response
Biomarker subsets, exploratory biomarkers and safety
population_or_material: The full analysis set of anti–PD-(L)1-resistant advanced melanoma patients in MONETTE.
requested_items: Full-analysis-set BICR ORR arm counts/proportions and adjusted OR; PFS/OS arm medians and primary HRs. Exclude safety-set/investigator responses, subgroups, event counts and landmark survival rates.
